label: batch-46
tail:
Batch 46 authoring is complete: 15 draft items are placed across the A/B pages, all 15 Step 1 records are hash-current and marked `ready`, and no owner override was used. The new second-derivative composition lemma supplies the rule used by both local-convergence examples.

Scoped checks passed: 13 proof prechecks, proof layout (15 items, 44 steps), 13 strict proof contracts, content policy, source coverage, source retrieval (4/4), focused dependency checks, and rendering (17 files). The full results are in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-46.notes.md), with the [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-46.pages.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-46.proof-contracts.json), [coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-46.coverage.json), and [cross-batch dependency evidence](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-46.cross-batch-dependencies.json).

The sources read include [Briggs, Henson, and McCormick](https://amath.colorado.edu/~stevem/appm6640/mgtut13notes.pdf), [van Brummelen](https://www.sintef.no/globalassets/project/evitameeting/2011/lecture1.pdf), and [Henson](https://digital.library.unt.edu/ark%3A/67531/metadc1402426/m2/1/high_res_d/15002749.pdf). The Banach calculus source record was reused from prior full-text evidence. Source history and stamps are in the [source evidence file](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-46.source-evidence.json).

Run-wide gates remain blocked outside batch 46: the item-level check reports 31 unrelated errors, and the batch dependency check stops on malformed YAML in an external item. The live run remains at Step 1 scaffold with an owner repair and recertification blocker. PE12’s `thm-pe12-l2-projector-w1p-stability` remains unresolved for the listed PE12 claims; batch 46 records it as not consumed. No shared plan or engine state was changed. Independent review and acceptance remain pending.
